tamil_meaning: தருமம் செய்ய நீ விரும்புவாயாக நல்ல செயல்களைச் செய்வதற்கு மனம் விருப்பம் கொள்ள வேண்டும். மனம் விருப்பம் கொள்ள அந்த நல்ல செயல்களை மகிழ்வுடன் செய்ய முடியும்.
source_english: Intend to do the right deeds.
meaning: Want to do good deeds. When the heart truly wishes to do right, good actions come naturally and joyfully instead of feeling like a duty.
situations: I want to do something meaningful for others but never start
I found a wallet on the road, should I return it?
Is it worth doing good when nobody notices?
I feel my life has no purpose
nallathu pannanum nu thonudhu aana start panna mudiyala
How do I become a better person?

tamil_meaning: கோபம் தணிக்கப்பட வேண்டியதாகும். கோபம் வரும் போது நமது சிந்திக்கும் அறிவு குறைந்து உணர்ச்சி வசப்பட்டுத் தவறான முடிவு எடுக்கும் சூழ்நிலை உருவாகும். அஃது எல்லோருக்கும் நல்லது அல்ல.
source_english: The nature of anger is to subside.
literal: Anger is meant to be cooled.
meaning: Anger must be calmed. When anger rises, thinking shrinks and we make wrong decisions, so let it cool before you act or speak.
situations: I get angry very easily
I shouted at my mother and regret it
My boss makes me so furious I want to quit on the spot
How do I control my temper?
enakku romba kovam varudhu
I snapped at my friend over something small

tamil_meaning: உன்னால் கொடுக்கக்கூடிய பொருளை யாசிப்பவர்க்கு ஒளிக்காது கொடு.
source_english: Help others as much as you can.
literal: Do not hide what you are able to give.
meaning: When someone in need asks and you are able to help, do not hide your means or pretend you cannot. Give what you can.
situations: My cousin asked for a loan and I lied that I have no money
Should I help a friend who is struggling financially?
I feel guilty for not sharing my notes with classmates
I'm being stingy and I know it
A poor man asked me for food and I walked away

tamil_meaning: ஒருவர், மற்றவர்க்குக் கொடுப்பதை, வேண்டாமென்று தடுக்காதே
source_english: Do not stop or avoid charitable deeds.
literal: Do not stop others from giving.
meaning: Never discourage or block someone else's generosity. When a person wants to give or help, do not stand in the way.
situations: My father wants to donate to a temple and I want to stop him
My wife gives money to her poor relatives and it annoys me
Should I stop my friend from helping a stranger?
I told my mom not to give to beggars
My roommate keeps lending money and I keep telling him not to

tamil_meaning: உன்னிடத்திலுள்ள பொருளை அல்லது இரகசியங்களைப் பிறர் அறியுமாறு சொல்லாதே. உனக்குள்ள பொருள் மற்றும் சிறப்புகளைப் பலரும் அறியும்படி பெருமையாகப் பேசாதே. உன்னுடைய பலவீனத்தையும் பலரும் அறியும்படி சொல்லாதே. அதனால் நல்ல பயன் எதுவும் இல்லை.
source_english: Do not brag about your possessions.
literal: Do not boast of what you possess.
meaning: Do not show off your wealth, achievements or secrets to everyone. Bragging invites envy and exposes your weaknesses.
situations: I love posting my new things on Instagram
I told everyone about my salary and now people treat me differently
My friend keeps flexing his car
Is it wrong to show off my achievements?
I shared my personal secrets with everyone and regret it

tamil_meaning: எப்போதும் முயற்சியைக் கைவிடக்கூடாது.
meaning: Never let go of your drive and effort. Keep trying even after failure; perseverance is what carries you to success.
situations: I failed my exam again and want to quit
I've lost all motivation
My startup failed, should I just give up?
I got rejected from 20 jobs
I feel like nothing I do works out
ellam vittudalam nu thonudhu

tamil_meaning: எண்ணும் எழுத்தும் மக்களுக்கு இன்றியமையாதன; ஆகவே, அவற்றை வீணென்று இகழ்ந்து கற்காமல் விட்டு விடாதே.
source_english: Do not despise numbers and letters.
literal: Do not neglect numbers and letters.
meaning: Mathematics and literacy are essential for every person. Do not look down on them or skip learning them as useless.
situations: I hate maths, why do I even need it?
I think school subjects are useless
I want to drop out because studies are boring
My kid refuses to learn reading
Is learning basics really important if I want to do business?

tamil_meaning: இரந்து வாழ்வது இழிவானது. அதனால் யாசிக்கக் கூடாது.
meaning: Living by asking others for things is degrading. Earn your own way and keep your dignity and self-reliance.
situations: I keep borrowing money from friends
I depend on my parents for everything even at 25
Is it okay to keep asking for help instead of working?
I feel ashamed asking my brother for money every month
How do I become financially independent?

tamil_meaning: யாசிப்பவர்கட்குக் கொடுத்துப் பிறகு உண்ண வேண்டும்.
literal: Share with the needy, then eat.
meaning: Before you eat, give to those who are hungry. Sharing your food and blessings with others is basic goodness.
situations: I waste a lot of food while others go hungry
Should I share my lunch with a classmate who has none?
How can I help hungry people near me?
My neighbour's family has no food this week
I feel selfish eating in front of someone hungry

tamil_meaning: உலக நடையை அறிந்துகொண்டு, அத்தோடு பொருந்துமாறு நடந்துகொள்.
literal: Live in harmony with the ways of the world.
meaning: Understand how society works and adjust your behaviour to fit in with others, cooperating rather than living in isolation.
situations: I moved to a new city and can't adjust
Everyone at my new job does things differently
I find it hard to adapt to change
I refuse to follow customs I don't understand
I feel like an outsider in my hostel

tamil_meaning: நல்ல நூல்களை எப்பொழுதும் படித்துக்கொண்டிரு. கற்றுக்கொள்வதை நிறுத்தாதே.
meaning: Keep reading good books and learning throughout life. Never stop learning, whatever your age.
situations: I finished college, do I still need to study?
I'm 40, is it too late to learn something new?
I stopped reading after school
Should I learn a new skill for my career?
I feel my knowledge is outdated

tamil_meaning: ஒருவரிடமும் பொறாமை கொண்டு பேசாதே.
source_english: Do not speak ill about others.
literal: Do not speak out of envy.
meaning: Do not speak about others with jealousy. Envy poisons your words and your own peace.
situations: I feel jealous of my friend's success
I talk badly about my colleague because she got promoted
My cousin got a better job and I can't stop comparing
I envy people on social media
Why do I feel bitter when others do well?
avanga success paathu poramaiya irukku

tamil_meaning: அதிக இலாபத்துக்காகத் தானியங்களைக் குறைத்து அளந்து விற்காதே.
source_english: Do not hamper development or creativity.
literal: Do not short-measure grain (cheat in trade).
meaning: Do not cheat customers by giving less than what was paid for to make extra profit. Be honest in business.
situations: Should I cut corners in my shop to make more profit?
My boss asks me to overcharge customers
Is it okay to sell low quality goods at full price?
I run a small business and competitors cheat, should I too?
I'm tempted to fudge the bill

tamil_meaning: கண்ணாற் கண்டதற்கு மாறாக சொல்லாதே
source_english: Do not see one and say another.
literal: Do not say otherwise than what you saw.
meaning: Do not report something different from what you actually saw. Tell the truth, especially when you are a witness.
situations: My friend wants me to lie about what happened
I saw my colleague steal but I'm afraid to tell
I lied to someone I care about
Should I cover up for my brother?
I gave a false statement to protect someone
I keep lying to my parents

tamil_meaning: மெய் எழுத்தான “ங்” என்ற எழுத்தின் உயிர்மெய் வடிவங்கள் எங்கும் பயன்பாட்டில் இல்லை. எனினும், “ங்” என்ற ஓரெழுத்து அதன் உயிர்மெய் எழுத்துக்களை காலத்தில் புதைந்துவிடாமல் காத்து வருகிறது. இந்த “ங்” எப்படி தன் வரிசையைக் காக்கிறதோ, அவ்வாறே நாமும் நம் உற்றார் உறவினர் அனைவரையும் கனிவுடன் காக்க வேண்டும்.
meaning: Like the letter ங, which humbly carries its family of letters, be humble and support your relatives and dependents, bending with grace rather than rigid pride.
situations: My relatives depend on me and I feel burdened
I am too proud to apologise
Should I support my extended family?
I'm rigid and refuse to compromise
How do I stay humble after success?

tamil_meaning: “சனி” என்றால் “குளிர்ந்த” என்பது பொருள். ஔவையார் இந்த பாடல் மூலமாக நம்மை குளிர்ந்த நீரில் நீராட சொல்கிறார்.
literal: Bathe in cool water (oil bath on Saturdays).
meaning: Bathe regularly in cool water and keep your body clean and refreshed; physical care keeps the mind calm too.
situations: I feel sluggish and heated all the time
I neglect my personal hygiene when stressed
What simple habits keep me healthy?
I don't take care of my body
How do I refresh myself after a tiring week?

tamil_meaning: பிறர் மகிழும்படி பேசு
meaning: Speak in a way that makes others glad. Sweet, kind words win hearts and make life smoother.
situations: People say I sound rude when I talk
How do I talk nicely to my in-laws?
My words always come out wrong
I want to communicate better with my team
How do I give feedback without hurting?

tamil_meaning: ஆடம்பர ஆசைகளுக்கு இடந் தராதே. தேவைகளை சுருக்கி வாழப் பழகுக.
literal: Do not build a house larger than needed.
meaning: Don't give in to luxury and show. Keep your needs simple and live within your means.
situations: I want to buy a huge house on a big loan to impress people
My EMIs are crushing me
Should I upgrade my lifestyle after a raise?
I keep buying expensive things I don't need
Everyone has a big car, I feel I need one too

tamil_meaning: நற்குண நற்செய்கை உடையவர் என்பது தெரிந்து கொண்டு ஒருவரோடு நட்பு செய்
literal: Know a person's nature, then befriend.
meaning: Make friends only after you know they have good character and good conduct.
situations: I trust people too quickly
I made new friends in college but I'm not sure they are good
How do I know if someone is a true friend?
I got hurt because I trusted the wrong person
Should I get close to this new group?

tamil_meaning: உன் தாய் தந்தையரை அன்புடன் போற்றி காப்பாற்று
meaning: Love, respect and take care of your parents, especially as they grow old.
situations: My parents are getting old and I live far away
I fight with my dad all the time
Should I put my parents in an old age home?
I don't spend time with my mother
My parents annoy me
amma appa kitta sandai poduren

tamil_meaning: ஒருவர் உனக்கு செய்த உதவியை மறவாதே
meaning: Never forget the help someone gave you. Remember and honour those who stood by you.
situations: I never appreciate what I have
Someone helped me a lot and I forgot to thank them
My friend helped me get this job and now I ignore him
How do I feel more thankful?
People who helped me feel I've forgotten them

tamil_meaning: எச்செயலையும் அதற்குரிய காலத்திலேயே செய்ய வேண்டும்
meaning: Do every task at its proper time. Opportunities have a season; delay and you miss them.
situations: I keep procrastinating my work
I always study at the last minute
I missed a great opportunity because I delayed
When is the right time to start investing?
I keep postponing important decisions
naalaiku pannalam nu thalli podren

tamil_meaning: பிறர் நிலத்தை திருடி அதன் மூலம் வாழாதே
literal: Do not live by grabbing others' land.
meaning: Do not take or live off land or property that belongs to others.
situations: My relatives want to grab our ancestral land
Should I occupy my neighbour's extra land since he's not using it?
There is a property dispute with my brother
I'm tempted to take more than my share of inheritance
Someone encroached on our plot

tamil_meaning: நல்லொழுக்கத்துக்கு மாறான செயல்களைச் செய்யாதே
literal: Do not do what is against good conduct.
meaning: Do not do things that go against good character and your true nature.
situations: My friends pressure me to do things I know are wrong
I did something I'm ashamed of
I'm becoming someone I don't like
Should I do something unethical to fit in?
I behaved badly at a party

tamil_meaning: பாம்புகளை பிடித்து விளையாடாதே
meaning: Do not play with dangerous things. Avoid needless risks that can harm you.
situations: I like doing dangerous stunts for videos
Is it okay to take crazy risks for thrill?
My friends dare me to do risky things
I'm messing with dangerous people for fun
I drive recklessly

tamil_meaning: இலவம் பஞ்சினாற் செய்த மெத்தையிலே உறங்கு
source_english: Sleep on a silk cotton bed.
meaning: Rest well and comfortably. Good sleep keeps the body and mind healthy.
situations: I can't sleep at night
I only sleep 4 hours because of work
I feel exhausted all the time
Is it okay to sacrifice sleep to study?
I'm burnt out
thookam varala

tamil_meaning: கபடச் சொற்களை பேசாதே
meaning: Do not speak cunning, deceitful words to trick or manipulate others.
situations: I manipulated my friend to get what I want
Is it okay to sweet talk people to get my way?
I tricked my parents into giving me money
My colleague manipulates everyone
I feel I'm being two-faced

tamil_meaning: இழிவான செயல்களை செய்யாதே
meaning: Do not do disgraceful, ugly acts that bring shame on you.
situations: I did something embarrassing when drunk
I'm tempted to do something disgraceful for money
I cheated in an exam and feel ashamed
How do I keep my dignity?
I acted badly in public

tamil_meaning: இளமைப் பருவத்திலேயே படிக்கத் தொடங்கி கல்வியைக் கற்று கொள்
meaning: Begin learning while young. What you study early stays with you for life.
situations: I'm a student but I waste all my time on my phone
I'm young, why should I study now?
I want to enjoy college instead of studying
My younger brother doesn't want to study
I regret not studying when I was young

tamil_meaning: தருமத்தை எப்போதும் மறவாமல் செய்
meaning: Never forget your moral duty. Keep doing what is right, every day, not just when convenient.
situations: I've become so busy I forgot my values
I only do good when it's convenient
How do I stay ethical in a corrupt workplace?
I feel I've lost my moral compass
I ignore my responsibilities to others

tamil_meaning: மிகுதியாக தூங்காதே
meaning: Do not sleep excessively. Too much sleep breeds laziness and wastes your life.
situations: I sleep 12 hours and still feel lazy
I can't wake up in the morning
I sleep through my alarms and miss classes
I spend my whole weekend in bed
I keep napping instead of working

tamil_meaning: யாரையும் கோபத்தில் கடிந்து பேசிவிடாதே.
meaning: Do not scold or speak sharply to others in anger. Let go of harsh words.
situations: I keep yelling at my kids
I scold my juniors harshly at work
I always criticise my wife
How do I stop shouting at people?
I lost my temper and scolded my maid

tamil_meaning: தான் செய்யத் தொடங்கிய தருமத்தை விடாமல் செய்வதே விரதமாகும் (அல்லது) பிற உயிர்களுக்குத் துன்பம் செய்யாமல் அவற்றைக் காப்பாற்றுவதே தவம் ஆகும்.
meaning: Steadily protecting others and continuing the good you started is the real penance, more than rituals or fasting.
situations: I fast and do poojas but I'm unkind to people
What is real spirituality?
I started helping an NGO but stopped
Is ritual more important than kindness?
I want to protect animals and nature

tamil_meaning: உன் உடலாலும் பொருளாலும் பிறருக்கு நன்மை செய்து வாழ்
literal: Live so that you are useful to others.
meaning: Use your strength and wealth to benefit others. A life is rich when it is useful to people.
situations: I feel my life is useless
How can I contribute to society?
I only think about myself
I have money and time, how should I use it?
I want my work to matter

tamil_meaning: இழிவான குணஞ் செயல்களை நீக்கு
meaning: Get rid of mean, low qualities and petty behaviour in yourself.
situations: I have some bad habits I want to drop
I'm petty and hold grudges over small things
How do I become a better version of myself?
I behave meanly when I'm insecure
I want to remove my negative traits

tamil_meaning: நன்மை தரக்கூடிய நல்ல குணங்களைப் பின்பற்றுவதை நிறுத்திவிடாதே(கைவிடேல்).
meaning: Never give up your good qualities, whatever pressure or temptation comes.
situations: Everyone around me is corrupt, should I also compromise?
I'm losing my good values in this job
Being nice gets me nowhere, should I change?
I'm tempted to give up my principles for money
People take advantage of my kindness

tamil_meaning: நல்லவரோடு நட்பு செய்து பின் அவரைப் பிரியாதே
literal: Do not part after joining (good friends).
meaning: Once you have made good friends, stay loyal; do not abandon them.
situations: I'm drifting apart from my best friend
I ignored my old friends after getting rich
Should I cut off a good friend over a small fight?
How do I keep friendships alive?
My friend and I stopped talking after an argument

tamil_meaning: பிறருக்குக் கேடு விளைவிக்கும் செயல்களைச் செய்யாதே.
meaning: Do not do things that harm others. Give up revenge and the urge to ruin anyone.
situations: I want revenge on my ex
I want to sabotage my colleague's project
Someone hurt me and I want to hurt them back
I'm planning to spread something bad about someone
I feel like destroying the person who betrayed me

tamil_meaning: கற்றவர் சொல்லும் நூற் பொருளைக் கேட்பதற்கு முயற்சி செய்
meaning: Make an effort to learn by listening to the learned and asking questions.
situations: I'm afraid to ask doubts in class
I don't understand my job but I'm scared to ask
How do I learn faster?
I never listen to advice
I feel stupid asking questions

tamil_meaning: உங்களுக்குத் தெரிந்த கைத்தொழிலை மற்றவர்களிடமிருந்து ஒளியாமற் செய்து கொண்டிருக்கவும்.
meaning: Do not hide the skills you have. Practise your craft openly and share it.
situations: I'm good at drawing but I hide it
I don't share my skills with juniors because I fear competition
Should I pursue my hobby seriously?
I'm shy about showing my talent
I don't teach others what I know

tamil_meaning: பிறர் பொருளைத் திருடுவதற்கு ஆசைப்படாதே.
meaning: Do not even wish to take what belongs to others. Wealth gained by theft or exploitation never lasts.
situations: I'm tempted to steal money from my office
My friend is planning a scam and wants me to join
Is it okay to pirate stuff?
I took something from a shop without paying
I want easy money even if it's illegal

tamil_meaning: குற்றமான விளையாட்டை விட்டு விடு (நீக்கு)
meaning: Give up harmful, wrong kinds of play, such as cruel pranks and games that hurt or corrupt.
situations: My friends play cruel pranks on juniors
I'm addicted to violent games
Is ragging just harmless fun?
I bully someone for fun
We play games that hurt animals

tamil_meaning: வாழ்வில் செயற்கையாக ஏற்படும் துன்பத்தை நீக்கு
meaning: Remove the needless troubles and scandals you create in your own life; keep away from drama and gossip that bring grief.
situations: My life is full of unnecessary drama
There's a lot of gossip and politics in my office
I keep getting into messy situations
I'm stressed by rumours about me
How do I stop creating problems for myself?

tamil_meaning: தர்மசக்கர நெறிப்படி வாழ வேண்டும். ( அரசன் = ஆள்பவர், தலைவர் )
source_english: Obey the laws of the land.
literal: Stand by the just order (rule of law).
meaning: Follow the righteous path laid by just rule and the laws of the land.
situations: Is it okay to break traffic rules if no one is watching?
Should I bribe the official to get my work done?
I want to avoid paying taxes
Rules seem pointless to me
My friend drives without a licence

tamil_meaning: அறிவொழுக்கங்களில் நிறைந்த பெரியோர்களுடன் சேர்ந்து இரு.
meaning: Spend your time with wise, learned and virtuous people.
situations: My friends are a bad influence
How do I find good mentors?
I want to surround myself with better people
Who I spend time with makes me lazy
Should I join a group of serious learners?

tamil_meaning: பொய்யான வார்த்தைகளை மெய் போலப் பேசாதே
literal: Do not speak false things as true (embellish).
meaning: Do not dress up lies to look like truth, or decorate stories with falsehood.
situations: I exaggerate my achievements in interviews
I made up a story to look cool
Should I fake my resume?
I keep embellishing stories
I told a lie that sounded true and now it's growing

tamil_meaning: புகழுக்குக் காரணமான நல்ல குணங்களை மறந்து விடாதே.
literal: Do not forget the good qualities that bring honour.
meaning: Never forget the good qualities and right conduct that earn you respect.
situations: After getting famous I forgot my roots
How do I keep my reputation clean?
I've stopped behaving well since I got promoted
People used to respect me and now they don't
I want to be remembered as a good person

tamil_meaning: கேட்பவருக்குக் கோபமும் வெறுப்பும் உண்டாகும்படி பேசாதீர்
literal: Do not speak so others frown.
meaning: Do not say things that make others angry or disgusted. Avoid hurtful words.
situations: My jokes hurt people
I keep offending people without meaning to
I said something that hurt my sister
My sarcasm is ruining my friendships
How do I stop hurting people with my words?

tamil_meaning: ஒருபொதும் சூதாட்டத்தை விரும்பாதே.
meaning: Never be drawn to gambling. It destroys wealth, peace and families.
situations: I lost money in online betting
I'm addicted to rummy apps
Should I put all my savings in crypto to get rich fast?
My dad is gambling away our money
I bet on cricket matches
I want to try IPL betting

tamil_meaning: செய்யும் செயல்களைத் தவறோ குறையோ ஏதும் இல்லாமல் செய்யவும்
meaning: Whatever you do, do it well and without careless mistakes. Give your best effort.
situations: I do my work half-heartedly
My boss says my work is sloppy
How do I stop making careless mistakes?
Is it okay to just do the minimum?
I want to be excellent at my job

tamil_meaning: நீ பழகும் நபர்கள் நல்ல குணங்கள் உடையவர்களா என நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து பின்பு அவர்களுடன் பழகு.
literal: Know the place (company) before you join.
meaning: Examine whether people are of good character before associating with them.
situations: Should I join this new friend group?
I'm not sure about this company's culture
How do I pick the right people to hang out with?
I joined bad company and got in trouble
My new roommates seem shady

tamil_meaning: பெரியோர் 'சீ' என வெறுக்கும்படி வீணாய்த் திரியாதே
literal: Do not roam about so that others say 'chee'.
meaning: Do not wander aimlessly or behave in a way that makes respected people look at you with contempt.
situations: I just roam around with friends doing nothing
People in my area look down on me
I have no direction in life
My relatives think I'm a waste
I hang out all night with no purpose

tamil_meaning: பிறருடன் பேசும் பொழுது மறந்தும் குற்றமுண்டாகப் பேசாதே
meaning: Be careful when speaking. Do not let careless or faulty words slip out, even by mistake.
situations: I said something stupid in a meeting
I blurt things out without thinking
How do I speak confidently in an interview?
I keep saying the wrong thing
I revealed something I shouldn't have

tamil_meaning: முயற்சியின்றிச் சோம்பேறியாகத் திரியாதே.
meaning: Do not idle around without effort. Laziness wastes your talents and your life.
situations: I feel lazy and unmotivated
I don't do anything all day
I'm a somberi, how to change?
I avoid work and just scroll my phone
I have time but I'm too lazy to use it
somberithanam jaasthi

tamil_meaning: பெரியோர்கள் உன்னைத் தக்கவன்(யோக்கியன்,நல்லவன்) என்று புகழும்படி நடந்துக்கொள்
literal: Live so that you are called worthy.
meaning: Behave so that the wise call you a trustworthy, worthy person.
situations: People don't trust me anymore
How do I become reliable?
I keep breaking my promises
I want my boss to trust me with bigger work
How do I rebuild my reputation?

tamil_meaning: யாசிப்பவர்களுக்குத் தானம் செய்.
meaning: Love giving to those in need. Let charity be a joy, not a burden.
situations: Should I donate part of my salary?
I want to help poor people
Is charity really useful?
I feel bad seeing beggars but don't give
How much should I give to others?

tamil_meaning: நாராயணமூர்த்திக்குத் தொண்டு செய்
meaning: Devote yourself in service to God (Thirumal). Humble service to the divine and to all beings purifies the heart.
situations: I've lost touch with God
Should I pray even when life is good?
How do I find peace through faith?
I want to be more spiritual
I feel empty, does devotion help?

tamil_meaning: பாவச் செயல்களைச் செய்யாமல் இரு.
meaning: Keep away from sinful actions. Bad deeds return to the doer.
situations: I've done a lot of bad things, can I change?
Does karma really come back?
I feel guilty for something wrong I did
I'm tempted to do something wicked
How do I stop doing wrong things?

tamil_meaning: முயற்சி செய்யும் பொழுது வரும் உடம்பின் வருத்தத்திற்கு அஞ்சி அதனை விட்டு விடாதே.
literal: Do not give room to (fear of) hardship.
meaning: Do not give up your effort because of the bodily pain and hardship that come with it. Don't let hardship defeat you.
situations: Training for the marathon is so painful I want to stop
Life is so hard, I feel like crying all the time
I feel depressed and stuck
Hard work is exhausting, should I give up?
Everything is going wrong in my life
romba kastama irukku

tamil_meaning: ஒரு வேளையை முடிப்பதற்கான வழிமுறைகளை நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து அறிந்த பின்பு அச்செயலைச் செய்யத் தொடங்கவும்
meaning: Think carefully about the means and consequences before starting any task. Plan, then act.
situations: I make impulsive decisions and regret them
Should I quit my job without a plan?
How do I make big decisions?
I jumped into a business without thinking and it failed
I want to invest but I haven't researched

tamil_meaning: கடவுளைப் பழிக்காதே.
meaning: Do not mock or insult God or what others hold sacred.
situations: I make fun of my friend's religion
I'm angry at God for my suffering
Is it okay to mock people's beliefs?
I disrespected a temple
I don't believe, should I still respect it?

tamil_meaning: உன் நாட்டில் வசிக்கும் மக்களுடன் பகை இல்லாமல் வாழ்
source_english: Live in unison with your countrymen.
literal: Live in harmony with your country(men).
meaning: Live peacefully with the people of your land, without hostility.
situations: I have fights with my neighbours
I don't get along with people from other communities
How do I live peacefully in my society?
There's tension in my apartment association
I feel hatred towards people of another region

tamil_meaning: மனைவி சொல் கேட்டு ஆராயாமல் நடவாதே.
literal: Do not blindly heed whispered counsel (traditionally: a spouse's word) without examining it.
meaning: Do not act on what someone close whispers to you without examining it yourself. Think for yourself before acting on advice, however dear the adviser.
situations: I always do whatever my partner says without thinking
Someone keeps filling my ears against my family
Should I follow advice blindly?
I made a bad decision because someone influenced me
How do I think independently?

tamil_meaning: பழைமையை மறவாதிருக்க வேண்டும் (பழங்கால மற்றும் பண்டைய முறையிலான நம் தமிழ் கலாச்சாரத்தை விட்டுக் கொடுக்காமல் இயற்கையோடு ஒத்து வாழ வேண்டும்)
meaning: Do not forget your heritage, traditions and roots. Respect the wisdom of the past.
situations: I've forgotten my culture after moving abroad
My kids don't speak Tamil
Are traditions still relevant?
I feel ashamed of my village roots
How do I stay connected to my heritage?

tamil_meaning: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால் தோல்வியில் தான் முடியும் எனத் தெரிந்தே அதைத் தொடங்காதே.
source_english: Don't compete if defeat is certain.
literal: Do not pursue what will surely fail.
meaning: Do not start or continue something you know will end in defeat. Choose your battles wisely.
situations: Should I keep fighting a case I'm sure to lose?
I keep chasing someone who doesn't love me
My business is clearly failing, should I keep putting money in?
Should I compete with a much stronger rival?
When should I let go of a dream?

tamil_meaning: நல்வினை செய்தலை எவ்வளவு இடையுறு வந்தாலும் உறுதியாகத் தொடரவும்
meaning: Keep doing good firmly, however many obstacles come.
situations: I try to be good but people mock me
Doing the right thing is getting me into trouble
Should I keep helping even when it's hard?
Obstacles keep stopping my good work
How do I stay committed to doing good?

tamil_meaning: நாட்டில் உள்ள பலரும் ஒத்துக்கொள்ளத்தக்க நல்ல காரியங்களைச் செய்
source_english: Do what is acceptable to the nation.
meaning: Do things that most good people in society would agree are right and beneficial.
situations: Is my plan good for society?
My actions are legal but people disapprove
How do I know if what I'm doing is right?
My business harms the local people
Should I care what society thinks?

tamil_meaning: உன்னுடைய நல்ல நிலையில் இருந்து என்றும் தாழ்ந்து விடாதே.
literal: Do not slip from your (good) standing.
meaning: Never fall from your good position and principles. Hold on to the dignity you have earned.
situations: I used to be disciplined and now I've fallen apart
I'm lowering my standards to please people
How do I not lose my position after success?
I compromised my dignity for a relationship
I'm slipping back into old bad habits

tamil_meaning: வெள்ளபெருக்கில் நீந்தி விளையாடாதே
source_english: Don't jump into a watery grave.
meaning: Do not play in dangerous floods or deep waters. Respect forces stronger than you and avoid reckless risks.
situations: My friends want to swim in a flooded river
Is it okay to take risky selfies at waterfalls?
I like adrenaline adventures without safety
Should I go to the beach during a storm?
I take dangerous risks to feel alive

tamil_meaning: நோயைத் தரும் சிற்றுண்டிகளை அதிகமாக உண்ணாதே
meaning: Do not eat too many unhealthy snacks that bring illness.
situations: I eat junk food every day
I can't stop snacking at night
I'm addicted to chips and sweets
How do I eat healthier?
Fast food is making me sick

tamil_meaning: அறிவை வளர்க்கும் பல நூல்களைப் படி
meaning: Read many books that grow your knowledge and wisdom.
situations: I want to start reading books
Is reading still useful in the age of YouTube?
I only read for exams
What should I read to become wiser?
I haven't read a book in years

tamil_meaning: நெற்பயிரை விளையச் செய்வதை உன் வாழ்க்கை தொழிலாகக் கொண்டு வாழ்.
meaning: Take up farming and producing food as an honourable livelihood; value those who grow what we eat.
situations: Should I leave my IT job and take up farming?
Is farming a respectable career?
My family owns land, should I cultivate it?
I want to grow my own food
Young people don't want to farm anymore

tamil_meaning: ஒழுக்கந் தவறாமல் நேர்வழியில் நட
meaning: Always behave rightly and walk the honest, straight path.
situations: How do I stay on the right path?
I'm tempted to take shortcuts
I want to live an honest, disciplined life
Should I be straightforward even when it costs me?
My manners have gotten bad

tamil_meaning: பிறர் வருந்தத் தகுந்த தீ வினைகளைச் செய்யாதே
literal: Do not go near deeds that cause suffering.
meaning: Do not do wicked deeds that make others suffer.
situations: I'm part of a group that harasses people
I want to damage my ex's car
Is it wrong to break things when angry?
My actions are hurting my family
I joined others in trolling someone online

tamil_meaning: பயன் இல்லாத அற்ப வார்த்தைகளைப் பேசாதே.
literal: Do not speak trivial, useless words.
meaning: Avoid empty, petty, worthless talk.
situations: I talk too much nonsense
I waste hours chatting about nothing
My friends only talk about petty things
I use a lot of bad words
How do I speak more meaningfully?

tamil_meaning: மிகுந்த உணவு உறக்கம் முதலியவற்றால் நோய்க்கு வழிவகை செய்யாதே.
literal: Do not give room to disease.
meaning: Do not invite illness through overeating, oversleeping or careless habits. Live healthily.
situations: I never exercise and I'm gaining weight
I smoke and drink a lot
My lifestyle is very unhealthy
I keep falling sick
I ignore my health for work
doctor said my sugar is high

tamil_meaning: பெரியோர்களால் பழிக்கப்படும் இழிவான சொற்களான பொய்,கடுஞ்சொல் ஆகியவற்றைப் பேசாதே.
literal: Do not utter what is condemned (lies, harsh words).
meaning: Do not speak words the wise condemn, such as lies and cruel speech.
situations: I swear a lot when I'm angry
I abused someone verbally
I use vulgar language with friends
I lied and insulted someone
How do I clean up my language?

tamil_meaning: பாம்புபோலக் கொடிய குணம் கொண்டவர்கள் உடன் பழகாதே.
literal: Do not associate with snake-like people.
meaning: Keep away from cruel, venomous people who may strike you.
situations: My friend is toxic but I can't leave
My colleague backstabs everyone
How do I deal with a manipulative person?
I keep getting close to dangerous people
My partner is cruel to me

tamil_meaning: குற்றம் உண்டாகும்படி எதையும் பேசாதே.
literal: Do not speak so as to cause faults.
meaning: Do not say anything that leads to blame, error or harm, including words that incriminate you or others.
situations: I said something that got me into trouble
I posted something online that backfired
I blamed someone wrongly
Should I admit everything in writing?
My words were misunderstood and caused a problem

tamil_meaning: பெருமையை அடையும் படியான நல்ல நிலையிலே நில்
literal: Stand so as to win honour.
meaning: Stay on the path that brings you honour and dignity.
situations: How do I earn respect?
I want to make my family proud
Should I take a shortcut to success?
I want to be respected in my field
I want to live with honour

tamil_meaning: உன்னையே நம்பியவர்களைக் காப்பாற்றி வாழ்
literal: Protect and cherish those who rely on you.
meaning: Take care of those who depend on you and those who stood by you.
situations: My employees depend on me
My old mentor needs help now
I'm neglecting people who rely on me
Someone who supported me is struggling
How do I take care of my team?

tamil_meaning: விளைநிலத்தை உழுது அதில் பயிர்செய்து உண்.(அ)விவசாயத்தை வாழ்க்கைத் தொழிலாகக் கொள்
meaning: Earn your food by honest labour, such as working the land; live by your own productive work.
situations: I want to earn by my own hard work
Is physical work beneath me?
I live off others' money
How do I value honest labour?
I want a simple, productive life

tamil_meaning: அறிவிலே சிறந்த பெரியோர்களை உனக்குத் துணையாகப் பேணிக்கொள்
source_english: Seek help from the old and wise.
literal: Take the great (wise elders) as your support.
meaning: Keep wise, learned elders close as your guides and helpers.
situations: I don't have anyone to guide me
Should I ask my grandparents for advice?
How do I find a mentor?
I'm confused and need guidance
I ignore advice from experienced people

tamil_meaning: அறியாமையைப் போக்கு
meaning: Get rid of ignorance. Learn, question and see things clearly.
situations: I believe everything I see on WhatsApp
I don't know anything about money management
How do I stop being so naive?
I'm ignorant about my own rights
I fall for fake news

tamil_meaning: அறிவில்லாத சிறுவனோடு கூடித் திரியாதே.
literal: Do not mingle with foolish youths.
meaning: Do not hang around with immature, senseless people who lead you astray.
situations: My friends are immature and get me into trouble
My gang always does stupid things
Should I stop hanging out with my childhood friends who do nothing?
My friends make me skip class
I follow my friends into silly fights

tamil_meaning: பொருள்களை(செல்வம் உட்பட)வீண் செலவு செய்யாமற் பாதுகாத்து வாழ்.
meaning: Protect your wealth and do not waste it on needless spending; save and manage money wisely.
situations: I spend my entire salary every month
How do I start saving money?
I waste money on online shopping
I have no savings at 30
Should I make a budget?
salary vandha udane kaali aagudhu

tamil_meaning: யாருடனும் தேவையில்லாமல் சண்டை பொடுவதை ஒரு வேலையாகச் செய்யாதே
literal: Do not make fighting your occupation.
meaning: Do not pick needless fights and quarrels with people as a habit.
situations: I keep getting into fights
I argue with everyone online
My family always quarrels
How do I stop picking fights?
I fight with my sibling every day

tamil_meaning: எதனாலும் மனக்கலக்கம் அடையாதே
literal: Do not let your mind waver.
meaning: Do not let anything shake your mind. Stay steady and clear instead of being confused or anxious.
situations: I can't decide between two job offers
I overthink everything
I feel anxious and confused
I keep changing my mind
How do I stay calm under pressure?
I can't concentrate on studies

tamil_meaning: பகைவன் உன்னைத் துன்புறுத்தி உன்னை வெல்வதற்கு இடம் கொடுக்காதே.
literal: Do not give room to your enemy.
meaning: Do not leave openings for an enemy to hurt or defeat you. Guard your weaknesses.
situations: My rival at work is waiting for me to fail
Someone is trying to bring me down
How do I protect myself from a jealous colleague?
I gave my competitor information by mistake
I'm too open with people who don't like me

tamil_meaning: சாதாரணமான விஷயத்தை மாயாஜால வார்தைகளால் பெரிதாகக் கூறாதே.
meaning: Do not blow ordinary things out of proportion with dramatic words.
situations: I always overreact to small problems
My friends say I'm a drama queen
I exaggerate my problems
I make a big deal out of everything
I overhype my plans

tamil_meaning: மிகுதியாக உண்ணுதலை விரும்பாதே.
meaning: Do not crave or indulge in eating too much.
situations: I eat too much at every meal
I stress eat
I can't control my food cravings
I eat even when I'm not hungry
How do I stop binge eating?

tamil_meaning: எப்போதும் யாருடனாவது சண்டையிடுவதற்காகப் போர் முனையிலே நிற்காதே
literal: Do not stand at the battle front.
meaning: Do not always place yourself at the front of conflicts, eager to fight; avoid joining quarrels and unjust fights.
situations: My friends want me to join a fight against another group
I always jump into others' arguments
Should I join the protest that's turning violent?
I like confrontation
I keep getting dragged into other people's conflicts

tamil_meaning: மூர்க்க குணம் கொண்டவர்கள் உடன் பழகாதே
literal: Do not agree with the obstinate.
meaning: Do not associate or go along with stubborn, brutish, unreasonable people.
situations: My uncle is stubborn and never listens
How do I deal with an aggressive, unreasonable boss?
My friend never accepts he's wrong
Should I keep arguing with someone who won't listen?
I'm stuck with a hot-headed teammate

tamil_meaning: பிற மாதரை விரும்பாமல் உன் மனைவியுடன் மட்டும் சேர்ந்து வாழ்.
literal: Be faithful to your noble spouse.
meaning: Stay faithful to your spouse alone; desire no other. Today this speaks to any committed relationship: be loyal and true to the one you are with.
situations: I'm attracted to someone other than my wife
My marriage is boring, should I look elsewhere?
How do I stay loyal in a long relationship?
I'm tempted to cheat on my husband
How do I keep my marriage strong?
I was unfaithful to my boyfriend and feel guilty
I'm seeing someone else behind my partner's back

tamil_meaning: நல்லொழுக்கம் உடைய பெரியோர் சொல்லைக் கேட்டு நட.
literal: Listen to the words of the noble.
meaning: Listen to and follow the advice of good, virtuous people.
situations: I never listen to my teachers
My elders give advice and I ignore them
Should I follow my mentor's advice?
I think I know better than everyone
Whose advice should I trust?

tamil_meaning: விலைமாந்தர் உடன் உறவு கொள்ளாமல் விலகி நில்
literal: Keep away from the house of those who sell love (illicit relations).
meaning: Stay away from illicit, transactional relationships that destroy health, wealth and family.
situations: I'm tempted by illicit relationships
My friends go to shady places and invite me
How do I resist temptation?
I'm wasting money on unhealthy relationships
I'm drawn to a secret affair

tamil_meaning: சொல்லப்படும் பொருளைச் சந்தேகம் நீங்கும்படி சொல் பேசுவதைத் தெளிவாகப் பேசு சொல்வதற்கு முன், இதைச் சொல்ல வேண்டுமா? என்று ஆராய்ந்து, பின் சொல்க எதைச் சொல்ல/பேச வேண்டும்? எப்பொழுது சொல்ல/பேச வேண்டும்? எதைச் சொல்லக்/பேசக் கூடாது? எப்பொழுது சொல்லக்/பேசக் கூடாது? எப்படிச் சொல்ல வேண்டும்? எப்படிச் சொல்லக் கூடாது?
meaning: When you speak, speak clearly so there's no confusion. Think whether it needs saying, then say it plainly.
situations: People misunderstand what I say
How do I communicate clearly at work?
I'm nervous about my presentation
My messages are always confusing
I ramble when I talk

tamil_meaning: நிலையில்லாத பொருள்களின் மேலுள்ள ஆசையை வெறுத்திடு
meaning: Reject obsessive desire for passing things such as lust, luxury and possessions. They never satisfy.
situations: I'm obsessed with buying designer brands
I'm infatuated with someone and can't focus
I always want more and more
My cravings control me
I want expensive things to feel happy

tamil_meaning: உன்னுடைய வலிமையை நீயே புகழ்ந்து பேசாதே
literal: Do not boast of your strength.
meaning: Do not praise your own strength or abilities. Let your deeds speak.
situations: How do I deal with an arrogant person?
I keep bragging about how smart I am
My colleague always praises himself
People say I'm full of myself
I want to stop showing off my skills

tamil_meaning: முந்திக்கொண்டு வாதிடாதே
literal: Do not rush to argue first.
meaning: Do not be the first to start an argument or debate; don't jump into disputes eagerly.
situations: I always start arguments in meetings
I jump in to argue before hearing people out
I love debating everything
My family says I argue too much
How do I stop being argumentative?

tamil_meaning: கல்வியாகிய நற்பொருளை விரும்பு
meaning: Love knowledge and learning as life's true wealth.
situations: I am losing motivation to study
How do I start enjoying studying?
I find learning boring
I want to love what I learn
I study only for marks

tamil_meaning: முக்தியை பெறுவதற்கான சன்மார்க்கத்திலே வாழ்க்கையை நடத்து
literal: Stand so as to attain liberation (peace).
meaning: Live a righteous life that leads to inner peace and spiritual freedom.
situations: I want peace of mind
What is the purpose of life?
I feel empty despite having everything
How do I find inner peace?
I'm restless and can't find happiness

tamil_meaning: உயர்ந்த குணங்கள் கொண்டவனாக வாழ்.
meaning: Live as a person of excellent character, an example to others.
situations: How do I become a good role model for my kids?
I want to be a better person
What makes someone truly good?
I want people to look up to me
How do I live an exemplary life?

tamil_meaning: ஊராருடன் நன்மை தீமைகளில் கலந்து வாழ்
meaning: Live with your community and take part in their joys and sorrows.
situations: I feel lonely and isolated
I don't know my neighbours
I avoid family functions
How do I feel part of a community?
I live alone in a new city and have no one

tamil_meaning: யாருடனும் கடினமாகப் பேசாதே
source_english: Don't be harsh with your words and deeds.
meaning: Do not speak harshly or bluntly. Hurtful words can't be taken back.
situations: I'm too blunt with people
I speak harshly to my wife when stressed
My words hurt my team
People say I'm rude
I said something cruel in an argument

tamil_meaning: வேண்டுமென்றே தீய செயல்களைச் செய்யாதே
meaning: Never plan or do harm on purpose.
situations: I'm planning to get back at my ex
I want to deliberately ruin his reputation
I'm plotting against my colleague
I knowingly did something to hurt her
I feel like harming someone on purpose

tamil_meaning: விடியற்காலையில் தூக்கத்திலிருந்து எழு நாள்தோறும் சூரியன் உதிக்கும் முன்பே தூக்கத்தில் இருந்து எழுந்திரு
meaning: Wake up early, before sunrise. The early morning brings health and clarity.
situations: I want to wake up early
My mornings are chaotic
How do I become a morning person?
I wake up at noon every day
How do I build a good daily routine?

tamil_meaning: பகைவர்களை நம்பாதே
meaning: Do not put your trust in those who are against you.
situations: My friend betrayed my trust
Should I trust someone who hurt me before?
My ex wants to be friends again
A rival is suddenly being nice to me
I keep trusting people who betray me

tamil_meaning: நம்மைச் சுற்றி உள்ளவர்களைப் பற்றி பிறரிடம் குறை சொல்லக் கூடாது அடுத்தவரைப் பற்றிப் புறம் (தவறாகப்) பேசக் கூடாது எந்த வழக்கிலும் ஒருபுடைச் சார்பாகப் பேசாமல் நடுநிலையுடன் பேசு. திருக்குறள் அதிகாரம் 19 - புறங்கூறாமை
literal: Do not speak partially (take sides unfairly).
meaning: Be impartial; do not take sides unfairly or speak ill behind people's backs.
situations: As a team lead I favour my friends
My parents always take my brother's side
I have to settle a dispute between two friends
I talk behind my friends' backs
How do I judge fairly?
